title: ABS-CBN ready to participate in discussions with MTRCB over ‘PBB’ complaints
summary: ABS-CBN said it has yet to receive a formal notice from the Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB), but assured that it will cooperate in discussions regarding complaints…

blocks.text: ABS-CBN said it has yet to receive a formal notice from the Movie and Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB), but assured that it will cooperate in discussions regarding complaints against “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab 3.0.” The regulatory board earlier said that it is reviewing more than 100 complaints it has received from viewers regarding scenes and interactions in the recent episodes of the reality show. The scenes in question as well as the nature of the complaints have yet to be disclosed to the public as of this writing. “The MTRCB has issued a statement regarding complaints it received about […]...
